column4: Minter::strategy coerces the held Arc into the trait object (same allocation); the mint decision is made in propagate on the strategy.
Minter::managed is a plain variant getter returning the vault if any; decisions are made by the vault and by the caller of managed_vault.
PreparedAccountCredential::after_upstream_401 only forwards to ManagedLease::after_upstream_401 (the decider) or returns the refusal unchanged.
PreparedAccountCredential::headers is a plain getter; headers were validated in validate_and_audit_mint.
PreparedAccountCredential::cache_binding is a plain getter; the binding is computed at mint time.
AccountStrategyRegistry::declared is a read-lock map lookup returning a clone; callers decide.
AccountStrategyRegistry::installed is a read-lock map lookup returning an Arc; callers decide.
AccountStrategyRegistry::managed_vault chains installed() and Minter::managed() lookups; the vault and callers decide.
PropagationError::fmt is Display formatting of error text; it decides nothing.
TokenExchangeStrategy::new only delegates to with_http_client with the default client; construction wiring is in with_http_client.
TokenExchangeStrategy::reap_expired is cache housekeeping that drops expired entries (skipped on unreadable clock); expiry is enforced at read time in cached().
TokenExchangeStrategy::store inserts a cache entry (reaping first when at MAX_CACHE_ENTRIES) and never refuses; reads are gated in cached().
Returns the kind for a ServerRequest variant; pure mapping, the relay-or-refuse decision is made in from_method.
Delegates to kind().method(); formatting a string, decides nothing.
Delegates to kind().prefix(); the ingress admit decision is made in is_bridge_reply_id.
Re-serializes already-deserialized params for the wire; the closed-set refusal happens earlier in from_method and plan.
Default wrapper that calls send_request then fires the delivery receipt commit; it admits or refuses nothing, the checks live in the gate and ask.
Emits a bridged-round counter with phase and width labels only; metrics plumbing, no decision.
Increments the destructive_confirmation_total counter; the refusal itself is decided by callers via refuse.
Plain getter returning the configured credential text; decisions are made by the callers.
Formats a configuration-coordinate label for error messages; decides nothing.
Returns the serde default cookie name "token"; validate_session decides whether a cookie name is acceptable.
Constructs an AccountsConfigError::Hosted value; the refusing callers decide.
Strips the env: prefix to name a reference in an error message; resolve_key makes the decision.
Wraps the Arc<LiveEnv> in EnvSecrets and decides nothing; the scheme refusal is made in EnvSecrets::resolve.
Trait-method plumbing that forwards to refresh_inner, which makes the token-response refusals.
Maps a token-type-hint enum to its RFC 7009 wire string; no decision.
Maps the closed config enum to fixed literal query pairs; shadowing a pinned parameter is prevented by the closed type, not by any check here.
Trait plumbing that forwards to get_inner, where guard makes the refusal.
Trait plumbing that forwards to post_inner, where guard makes the refusal.
Purely diagnostic: Certificate and Unclassified are both terminal, so a miss changes only what an operator reads.
